## What changed and what is demonstrably better?

Describe the user-facing or investigator-facing outcome. Internal test counts and added source cards are **not**, on their own, evidence of product progress.

### Closest existing alternative — mandatory for substantial product/Atlas changes

- **Nearest competitor or reusable OSS implementation:** [name and upstream documentation/benchmark links]
- **What it already handles:** [specific capability, not a promotional adjective]
- **What we are still worse at:** [scope, accuracy, availability, original-source checks, time/cost or UX]
- **Why build, reuse, retire, or compose?** [cite observed performance or licensing/integration constraints]

### Like-for-like evidence

- **Shared source/evidence set and task IDs:** [link to frozen inputs, permitted source access]
- **Competitor method and output receipt:** [real run link, or `NOT_EVALUATED`]
- **Atlas output and independently judged rubric:** [link, or `NOT_EVALUATED`]
- **Incorrectly accepted claims, false joins, and abstentions:** [measured counts and negatives]
- **Original functionality and source quote verification:** [separate from title/metadata retrieval]
- **Latency, operating cost and human effort:** [measured, or `NOT_EVALUATED`]
- **Decision:** [catch-up / comparable / potential edge unproven / demonstrated edge / integration-only]

### Evidence honesty checks

- [ ] No “beats” or “matches” claim without the same test, equivalent source access and actual competitor output.
- [ ] No internal mock, curated development benchmark or embedding similarity passed off as independently adjudicated correctness.
- [ ] Failed/unavailable third-party sources remain `UNAVAILABLE`, not “0 relevant”.
- [ ] Any Nocturnal private case/publication or Academic sealed holdout stays under its dedicated authorization.
- [ ] Source licenses, redistribution permissions and source SHA/URL evidence are retained.
- [ ] If no competitor run was possible, the relevant capability is stated as **not yet proven relative to competitors**.

For current Atlas substitutes, gaps and measurements see [the October 2026 competitor scorecard](../docs/COMPETITOR_ANCHORED_INTELLIGENCE_SCORECARD_2026_10_23.md) and [its machine-readable baseline](../research_materials/competitive_reference/competitor_relative_progress_v1.json). Update when a feature, official source or independent benchmark materially changes.
